tasks.title: A point with a clear repr
tasks.statement: Add a __repr__ method to the Point class that returns a string like Point(1, 2), the way the point would be written in code. The check prints the repr of a point and of a list containing the point.
tasks.hint: return f"Point({self.x}, {self.y})". A list shows its elements via repr.

tasks.title: Money: str and repr
tasks.statement: The Money class stores an amount. For the user, __str__ must give «5.00 ₽» (two digits after the point), and __repr__ must give Money(5). Write both methods.

tasks.title: An empty account is false
tasks.statement: Complete Account so that an account with a positive balance is truthy and one with a zero or negative balance is falsy (the condition if account: must work).

tasks.title: Basket length
tasks.statement: Basket already has an add method. Add __len__ so that len(basket) returns the number of items and an empty basket is falsy (without a separate __bool__).
tasks.hint: def __len__(self): return len(self.items). Python takes truthiness from the length.

tasks.title: Version equality and hash
tasks.statement: Write __eq__ and __hash__ for Version(major, minor): versions with the same numbers are equal, and can be put into a set and used as keys. Comparing with an object of another type (for example, a string) must simply give False, not an error.
tasks.hint: In __eq__: if not isinstance(other, Version): return NotImplemented. __hash__: hash((self.major, self.minor)).

tasks.title: Version ordering
tasks.statement: The Version class can already check equality and uses @total_ordering. Complete __lt__ so that versions are compared by (major, minor), and comparison with a foreign type returns NotImplemented (then Python itself raises TypeError).
tasks.hint: if not isinstance(other, Version): return NotImplemented; then compare the tuples (major, minor).

tasks.title: A custom temperature format
tasks.statement: Write Temperature.__format__(spec): the spec «c» (and the empty one) gives «21.0 °C», the spec «f» gives degrees Fahrenheit with one decimal place («69.8 °F»). Reject any other spec with ValueError.
tasks.hint: F = C * 9 / 5 + 32. Format numbers as f"{value:.1f}".

tasks.title: Settings as attributes
tasks.statement: Config keeps a dictionary in self._data. Complete __getattr__ so that config.host returns the value of the key "host". If the key is missing, raise AttributeError (then hasattr and getattr with a default work correctly).
tasks.hint: try: return self._data[name]; except KeyError: raise AttributeError(name).

tasks.title: An immutable order number
tasks.statement: In Order the id field must not change after creation, while total may. Write __setattr__: allow the first write of id, reject a repeated one with AttributeError. Other attributes are written as usual (via super().__setattr__, to avoid recursion).
tasks.hint: if name == "id" and "id" in self.__dict__: raise AttributeError(...); then super().__setattr__(name, value).
